title: Step 1 - Data Preprocessing in Python: Preparing Your Dataset for ML Models

cues.en: Hadelin: Hello, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: Welcome to part one, Data Preprocessing, and mostly, welcome to the practical activities of this course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第一部分：資料前處理，更歡迎來到這門課的實作活動。

cues.en: My name is Hadelin de Ponteves, and I am more than happy to welcome you into this course.
cues.zh: 我是 Hadelin de Ponteves，非常高興歡迎你加入這門課。

cues.en: We're about to embark on a super huge journey, but yet, a very exciting one, because we are gonna build together a series of machine learning models from all the branches of machine learning.
cues.zh: 我們即將展開一段龐大卻令人興奮的旅程，一起建立涵蓋機器學習各個分支的一系列模型。

cues.en: And speaking of these branches, well, you have them in front of you.
cues.zh: 說到這些分支，你現在眼前就看得到。

cues.en: That's the whole folder of this Machine Learning A-Z course, structured into all the different branches of machine learning.
cues.zh: 這是完整的 Machine Learning A-Z 課程資料夾，依照機器學習的不同分支整理。

cues.en: From Data Preprocessing, Regression, Classification, Clustering, Association Rule Learning, Reinforcement Learning, NLP, and Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 包括資料前處理、迴歸、分類、分群、關聯規則學習、強化學習、自然語言處理與深度學習。

cues.en: And now, we're about to start part one, Data Preprocessing.
cues.zh: 現在，我們要開始第一部分：資料前處理。

cues.en: And this is the first, very important step of this journey because, indeed, anytime you build a machine learning model, you always have a Data Preprocessing phase to work on.
cues.zh: 這是旅程中非常重要的第一步，因為每次建立機器學習模型，都必須先做資料前處理。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: You have to preprocess the data in the right way so that the machine learning model that you're gonna build can be trained the right way on the data.
cues.zh: 必須用正確方式處理資料，才能讓接下來建立的機器學習模型，在這些資料上正確訓練。

cues.en: So, we have to start with this step.
cues.zh: 所以一定要從這一步開始。

cues.en: This will not be the most exciting step, but I will make sure to do this very efficiently, so that we can rapidly proceed to the branches of machine learning
cues.zh: 這不一定是最令人興奮的步驟，但我會有效率地帶你完成，讓我們盡快進入機器學習的各個分支，

cues.en: But before that, we have to master data preprocessing.

cues.en: And that's exactly what we are gonna do in this part one.
cues.zh: 這正是第一部分要做的事情。

cues.en: So if we are on the same page, let's do this, let's go inside this, part one, data preprocessing folder, which is structured the following way.
cues.zh: 如果都準備好了，就進入 Part 1 Data Preprocessing 資料夾，裡面的結構如下。

cues.en: It has only one section, luckily for us, so that we can quickly get to the machine learning models.
cues.zh: 幸好這部分只有一章，讓我們能很快進入機器學習模型。

cues.en: And as any folder in this course, well, it is structured the following way in two folders, first Python, and then R.
cues.zh: 和課程中的其他資料夾一樣，裡面分成兩個資料夾，首先是 Python，再來是 R。

cues.en: This Python folder contains, of course, all the Python implementations and the dataset.
cues.zh: Python 資料夾包含全部 Python 實作與資料集。

cues.en: And this R folder contains all the R implementations with the same dataset.
cues.zh: R 資料夾則包含全部 R 實作，以及同一份資料集。

cues.en: So now we're gonna go into Python, because each time you're in each section, anytime we build a model, we're gonna start first with Python and then R, okay?
cues.zh: 現在先進入 Python，因為每一章、每次建立模型時，都會先用 Python，再用 R。

cues.en: So that if you are more interested in Python, well, you take the first part.
cues.zh: 所以，如果你比較對 Python 有興趣，就看前半段。

cues.en: And if you're more interested in R, you take the second part.
cues.zh: 如果比較對 R 有興趣，就看後半段。

cues.en: And here I wanna say something very important.
cues.zh: 這裡有一件非常重要的事要先說明。

cues.en: This course is not meant for you to master both Python and R.
cues.zh: 這門課不要求你同時精通 Python 與 R。

cues.en: We just covered the two tools so that anyone can learn machine learning on their preferred tool.
cues.zh: 我們介紹兩種工具，是希望每個人都能用自己偏好的工具學習機器學習。

cues.en: So if you prefer Python, you can just do Python.
cues.zh: 喜歡 Python，就只做 Python。

cues.en: If you prefer R, you can just do R.
cues.zh: 喜歡 R，就只做 R。

cues.en: And if you wanna learn both, well, you're welcome to learn both, but you don't have to, that's what I wanna say, okay?
cues.zh: 如果想兩種都學，當然也歡迎，但不必勉強，這是我想表達的重點。

cues.en: And just to give you some context, let's say that this data set belongs to a retail company that collected some data from their customers, whether or not they purchased a certain product.
cues.zh: 先交代背景，假設這份資料屬於一家零售公司，記錄客戶是否購買某項產品。

cues.en: So here, each of the rows correspond to different customers.
cues.zh: 每一列都代表不同的客戶。

cues.en: And for each of these customers, well this company gathered their country, their age, their salary, and whether or not they purchased their product.
cues.zh: 公司替每位客戶蒐集了國家、年齡、薪資，以及是否購買產品等資料。
